_comment: DEMO DATA - Replace every entry with verified job listings before production. Set SITE_CONFIG.demoMode = false in assets/js/config.js once real, verified listings are in place. See README.md > 'How to add a job'. After editing this file run `node tools/build.js` to regenerate the static job pages in /remote-jobs/ and sitemap.xml.
_notice: These are fictional sample listings created only to test the interface. The companies do not exist and no application links are provided.

jobs.title: Remote Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description: Sample listing used to demonstrate the layout of a customer support role. The specialist answers product questions over email and live chat, keeps help-centre articles current and escalates technical issues to engineering.
responsibilities: Answer customer questions over email and live chat within agreed response times
Diagnose account and billing issues and resolve them end to end
Write and update help-centre articles based on common questions
Flag recurring product problems to the engineering team with clear reproduction steps
requirements: Clear written English and a calm, friendly tone
Comfortable working independently on a set schedule
Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
Previous support experience is helpful but not required
benefits: Fully remote within the United States
Paid time off and public holidays

jobs.title: Virtual Assistant (Part-Time)
jobs.description: Sample listing for a part-time virtual assistant supporting a small distributed team. The role covers calendar management, inbox triage, travel booking and light research, roughly 20 hours per week.
responsibilities: Manage calendars across multiple time zones and prevent scheduling conflicts
Triage a shared inbox and draft first-pass replies
Book travel and prepare simple itineraries
Keep internal documents, trackers and folders organised
requirements: Strong organisational habits and attention to detail
Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
Available for at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern time
No prior VA experience required — a short paid trial task is part of the process
benefits: Flexible hours around a fixed overlap window
Paid trial task before a longer commitment
Opportunity to grow into a full-time role

jobs.title: Data Entry Clerk — Work From Home
jobs.description: Sample listing for a six-month data entry contract. The clerk transfers records between systems, checks them against source documents and reports anything that looks inconsistent.
responsibilities: Enter and verify records in the company's internal database
Cross-check entries against scanned source documents
Maintain a daily accuracy rate above the agreed threshold
Report inconsistent or missing source data to the team lead
requirements: Typing speed of at least 45 words per minute
Comfortable with spreadsheets and repetitive detail work
Able to follow written procedures precisely
Located in Canada for payroll reasons
benefits: Set weekday schedule with no evening work
Equipment provided for the contract period

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)
jobs.description: Sample listing for a frontend engineer on a small product team. The role covers building accessible interfaces, improving performance and sharing ownership of the design system.
responsibilities: Build and maintain accessible, responsive product interfaces
Own performance budgets and keep Core Web Vitals healthy
Contribute components and documentation to the design system
Review pull requests and pair with other engineers
requirements: Three or more years building production frontends
Strong JavaScript, HTML and CSS fundamentals
Experience with a component framework and automated testing
Right to work in the United Kingdom

jobs.title: SEO Content Writer
jobs.description: Sample listing for a freelance writer producing long-form articles for a publisher's lifestyle and finance sections. Briefs, outlines and target keywords are supplied.
responsibilities: Write 1,200–2,000 word articles from supplied briefs and outlines
Research topics using primary sources and cite them
Apply on-page SEO guidance without keyword stuffing
Deliver two to four articles per week on schedule
requirements: Portfolio of published writing in any niche
Native-level written English
Comfortable taking editorial feedback
Able to hit deadlines without reminders
benefits: Long-term recurring assignments for reliable writers

jobs.title: Email Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description: Sample listing for a coordinator running the lifecycle email programme for an online retailer: campaign builds, list hygiene, A/B tests and weekly reporting.
responsibilities: Build and schedule campaigns in the email platform
Run subject line and layout A/B tests and document results
Maintain list hygiene, segments and suppression rules
Report on open, click and conversion trends each week
requirements: Familiarity with any major email marketing platform
Basic HTML comfort for template edits
Analytical mindset and careful proofreading
One year of marketing experience or a strong portfolio project
benefits: Fully remote within the United States

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Sample listing for a product designer working across research, interaction design and visual polish for a B2B web application.
responsibilities: Turn product problems into flows, wireframes and high-fidelity screens
Run lightweight usability sessions and summarise findings
Maintain and extend the shared component library
Work closely with engineers through implementation
requirements: Portfolio showing end-to-end product work, not only visuals
Strong Figma skills including components and variables
Experience designing for accessibility
Located in Australia or within two hours of AEST
benefits: Four-day work week trial in progress
Remote-first with optional Sydney co-working space

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: Sample listing for an SDR generating qualified meetings for the account executive team through outbound email, calls and social outreach.
responsibilities: Research target accounts and build prospect lists
Run outbound email and calling sequences
Qualify inbound enquiries against agreed criteria
Keep CRM records accurate and up to date
requirements: Confident on the phone and in writing
Resilient and comfortable with a daily activity target
Coachable and organised
No prior sales experience required — training provided
benefits: Structured promotion path to account executive

jobs.title: Remote Bookkeeper
jobs.description: Sample listing for a part-time bookkeeper looking after day-to-day transactions, reconciliations and month-end preparation for a portfolio of small business clients.
responsibilities: Record purchases, sales and expenses in the accounting system
Reconcile bank and card accounts weekly
Prepare month-end schedules for the accountant
Chase missing receipts and client paperwork
requirements: Two or more years of bookkeeping experience
Confident with cloud accounting software
Understanding of UK VAT basics
Discreet handling of confidential financial records

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description: Sample listing for an administrative coordinator keeping internal operations running: documentation, vendor coordination, meeting logistics and process upkeep.
responsibilities: Coordinate meetings, agendas and follow-up notes
Maintain internal documentation and shared drives
Process vendor paperwork and track renewals
Support onboarding logistics for new team members
requirements: Excellent written communication
Comfortable juggling several small deadlines at once
Experience with any project management tool
Authorised to work in the United States

jobs.title: Online English Tutor
jobs.description: Sample listing for an online tutor delivering one-to-one English lessons to adult learners, using a supplied curriculum and lesson plans.
responsibilities: Deliver scheduled one-to-one video lessons
Adapt supplied lesson plans to each learner's level
Leave short written feedback after every session
Track learner progress in the platform
requirements: Native or near-native English
Stable internet, webcam and headset
Patient, encouraging teaching style
Teaching certification is a plus, not a requirement

jobs.title: Medical Billing Specialist
jobs.description: Sample listing for a non-clinical billing specialist preparing and submitting claims, resolving denials and answering patient billing questions for a multi-site practice.
responsibilities: Prepare and submit claims accurately and on time
Investigate and resubmit denied claims
Answer patient billing enquiries by phone and portal message
Keep coding references and payer rules up to date
requirements: Two or more years in medical billing or coding
Familiarity with claim submission workflows
Careful handling of confidential patient information
Based in the United States
benefits: Remote with a fixed weekday schedule

jobs.title: AI Data Annotation Specialist
jobs.description: Sample listing for project-based annotation work: labelling text and image data, reviewing model responses against written guidelines and flagging edge cases.
responsibilities: Label text and image data against detailed guidelines
Compare and rank model responses for quality
Flag ambiguous cases for guideline clarification
Maintain agreed accuracy and throughput levels
requirements: Strong reading comprehension and attention to nuance
Able to apply written rules consistently over long sessions
Desktop or laptop computer with stable internet
No prior experience needed — a short qualification task applies
benefits: Work whenever suits you within weekly project windows

jobs.title: Entry-Level Remote Operations Assistant
jobs.description: Sample listing for a four-month paid internship supporting the operations team with reporting, scheduling and process documentation.
responsibilities: Compile weekly operational reports from existing dashboards
Keep shift schedules and trackers current
Document repeatable processes as short written guides
Support the team with ad-hoc research tasks
requirements: Currently studying or recently graduated
Comfortable with spreadsheets
Willing to ask questions and learn quickly
Located in Canada
benefits: Reference and possible full-time offer on completion

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
jobs.description: Sample listing for a senior support engineer handling escalated technical issues, writing internal runbooks and acting as the bridge between support and engineering.
responsibilities: Own escalated tickets through to resolution
Reproduce and document defects with clear technical detail
Write runbooks and train tier-one colleagues
Participate in a shared weekday on-call rotation
requirements: Four or more years in technical support or a similar role
Comfortable reading logs and writing basic SQL
Understanding of APIs, DNS and web infrastructure
Right to work in the United Kingdom
